K1.stone_why: Faceted bowls and wedge serifs keep the slanted display reading as cut stone with a firm baseline.
K1.carving_why: Facets are coherent and crisp across Bench press and the digits, and 6, 2 and 5 stay clear, though the 6 bowl is slightly lumpy.
K1.calm_why: A moderate slant gives forward motion without agitation; steady presence.
K1.personality_why: A recognisable chiselled italic voice, though very close to K2.
K1.oblique_why: Even, moderate slant with steady strokes that sits well beside the upright; no visible distortion.
K1.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis words separate clearly from the upright at 13 px without jumping out.
K1.fit_notes_why: Whole lines read smoothly, including Light, with comfortable spacing.
K1.fit_display_why: Titles, set weight and capitals hold up well as carved slanted accents.

K2.stone_why: Practically identical to K1: faceted, grounded, stony at display size.
K2.carving_why: Crisp, coherent facets and clear digits, with marginally sharper corners on the 5 and 6 than K1.
K2.calm_why: Steady moderate slant, calm with presence.
K2.personality_why: The same deliberate chiselled voice as K1; hard to tell apart.
K2.oblique_why: Even slant and steady spacing, comfortable next to the upright.
K2.fit_emphasis_why: Clear but quiet emphasis inside upright text.
K2.fit_notes_why: Readable full lines; the Light line stays legible.
K2.fit_display_why: Strong, legible set number and capitals.

K3.stone_why: The steeper slant and heavier faceting make the display lean forward more, so it reads less grounded than the others.
K3.carving_why: The most visibly carved facets, crisp and bold, but the 6 and 2 become more polygonal and slightly rough.
K3.calm_why: Its stronger lean and angular digits add urgency and a touch of restlessness.
K3.personality_why: The most distinctive and energetic: an unmistakably chiselled, dynamic italic.
K3.oblique_why: The slant is steeper and more contrasted with the upright, and wider glyphs hint at a mechanical skew in the digits.
K3.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis is the most clearly distinguished at 13 px, though slightly louder than needed.
K3.fit_notes_why: Whole lines feel more slanted and busier, which is less restful for hints.
K3.fit_display_why: Bold and energizing accents, at some cost to calm.

K4.stone_why: The shallowest lean keeps the display most grounded and monumental, still faceted.
K4.carving_why: Clean, crisp facets with clear digits; slightly softer than K3.
K4.calm_why: The steadiest of the four, with quiet confidence and no restlessness.
K4.personality_why: The gentle slant drifts toward the upright, so the oblique voice is the least distinct.
K4.oblique_why: Even, undistorted slant, though it is so mild that it sits almost too close to the upright.
K4.fit_emphasis_why: At 13 px the emphasis words separate the least from the upright.
K4.fit_notes_why: The most comfortable whole lines, including Light, calm and even.
K4.fit_display_why: Solid, legible carved accents, slightly less energetic.
